purpose: Epicor Kinetic cross-domain data, regional/deployment, paging and recovery review.

requiredPermissions: dedicated least-privilege Kinetic integration identity constrained by ERP user/data permissions and provider-supported access scopes
exact reviewed REST service or BAQ/read-projection allowlist; no wildcard service, process, Function or action authority
explicit approved Kinetic instance plus company/site scope discovered from the authorised environment
customer-edge HTTPS route for on-premises/private components; no direct cloud-to-private-network exposure
separate approval for any future write/process/Function surface; steady-state WFM ingestion remains read-only
dataAvailableOrExpected: manufacturing jobs/orders, operations, methods/routings, resource groups/work centres and production status where exposed to the reviewed identity
production data collection including labour reporting, completed quantities and plant-floor transaction evidence where the customer uses those Kinetic modules
planning/MRP/APS demand, capacity and resource-scheduling evidence, including skill/capability-based scheduling where configured
materials, inventory, WIP, purchasing, suppliers and real-time material-availability context
quality inspections, non-conformance, scrap/rework and quality-cost evidence where Quality Management/Epicor QMS is installed
assets/equipment, maintenance requests and preventive/break-fix maintenance context where Service & Asset Management or related modules are installed
products/parts/SKUs, bills of material, bills of operations/routings and engineering/product data where exposed
finance, job costing, project/cost-centre/accounting dimensions and actual manufacturing cost evidence
multi-company, multi-site, multi-currency, multi-language and country-specific configuration/context
customer-defined UD fields and customer-created data views/BAQs exposed through the reviewed REST surface
stableIdentifiers: preserve provider-native business-object keys only as source identifiers namespaced by connection, Kinetic instance, company/site, service/projection and service version
preserve company, site/plant and source service/projection identity on every record; never assume job, part, employee or resource identifiers are globally unique across companies/instances
preserve schema fingerprint and UD-field/projection version lineage so customer customisations and upgrades cannot silently reinterpret historical records

freshnessLatency.rest: WFM-controlled bounded reads from the reviewed REST/OData or BAQ surface; Epicor positions Kinetic data/services as real-time, but WFM records actual observation/ingestion timestamps and never substitutes marketing freshness for measured latency
freshnessLatency.baq: prefer narrow provider/customer-governed BAQ projections for recurring reads when they reduce authority and payload; preserve projection id, parameters and schema fingerprint
freshnessLatency.events: no generic provider webhook/event completeness contract is claimed by this evidence delta; polling/reconciliation remains authoritative unless separately proven

paginationDeltaEvents.pagination: discover the exact service/projection paging contract from authorised Kinetic REST help/metadata; require continuous page chains and checkpoint only after a complete bounded sequence
paginationDeltaEvents.delta: use provider/customer proven update timestamps or projection parameters only after their semantics are observed; use overlap replay and stable-id dedupe
paginationDeltaEvents.events: none claimed generically; customer BPM/Automation Studio/iPaaS events require separate interface/security evidence
paginationDeltaEvents.reconciliation: never infer deletion from BAQ, filtered, incremental, permission-limited or partial reads; authoritative absence requires a deliberately complete projection with proven source scope, page completeness and reconciliation

rateLimitsAndRetries: the public provider material reviewed here does not establish one universal Kinetic rate-limit contract; discover/measure the authorised deployment and keep concurrency bounded
401/403 stop blind retry and enter identity/scope/ERP-permission diagnostics; never broaden identity or fall back to executable service surfaces
429/retryable 5xx/network interruption use bounded exponential backoff with jitter for idempotent reads while preserving the source checkpoint
paging interruption, partial regional/site availability or projection errors trigger overlap replay/reconciliation before downstream data is treated as current
versionsRegionsCustomFields: Epicor documents versioned REST services; exact service versions available to a customer must be discovered from the authorised Kinetic environment rather than globally assumed

Kinetic supports cloud, on-premises and hybrid deployments; Epicor announced on 6 January 2026 that Kinetic 2028.1 is planned as the final on-premises feature release, with active support through 31 December 2029 and sustaining support thereafter
Kinetic supports multiple companies, sites, currencies and languages plus country-specific functionality; preserve original locale/currency/timezone/unit context and source authority
Epicor UD fields and user-defined services can add customer-specific fields/objects exposed through REST; schema negotiation and extension provenance are mandatory

cloud customers may be deployed in different provider regions while on-prem data location is customer controlled; connection/source identity must retain region/instance/company/site rather than collapsing them
dataGaps: no authorised Kinetic sandbox/customer tenant was available to prove authentication, exact URL/service/version discovery, effective API-key/access-scope behaviour, company/site isolation, denied writes or real read round-trips
public provider pages establish OData v4/query/metadata support but do not provide one universal customer-independent pagination, delta, rate-limit or webhook contract for every service
exact BAQ identifiers, parameters, fields, update timestamps and stable-key semantics are tenant-specific and must be discovered/reviewed before canonical mappings are certified
worker/skill data available inside Kinetic varies by licensed/configured modules and customer design; external HCM may remain the source authority
regional residency/cross-border controls depend on the chosen Epicor cloud region/customer architecture and require tenant/contract evidence before certification
constraintsRisks: full UI/service parity is powerful but broad: a generic REST identity can reach business objects, processes and Functions, so least-privilege read projection/service allowlists are mandatory
BAQs and custom UD fields improve implementation speed but can drift independently of standard services; schema fingerprints and projection lineage are required
multi-company/multi-site estates and acquisitions can reuse business identifiers; source scoping must prevent cross-company collisions and checkpoint reuse
on-prem/hybrid deployments add network, certificate, version and availability variance and must remain behind customer-controlled edge connectivity
no generic event completeness claim is made; treating automation/BPM callbacks as authoritative without recovery polling would risk silent gaps
